title: 3.1.7b Lab — Move with position.x
description: Make a Cube slide to the right each frame by incrementing position.x in draw().

steps.title: Create a Cube at the origin
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `cube = new Cube(0, 0, 0)` to place it at the center.
hints: The Cube starts at position (0,0,0) — the center of the scene.

steps.title: Move the cube in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), write `cube.position.x += 0.05` so the cube slides right a little each frame.
hints: draw() runs ~60 times per second. Adding 0.05 each frame means the cube moves about 3 units per second.

requirements.title: position.x is incremented
requirements.description: cube.position.x is incremented with += in draw().
